text:
olivia: Dropping a quick prototype for the stacktrace minimap + export changes. Top-right minimap, click-to-jump, drag-to-scrub. Kebab menu shows Download trace JSON + Copy trace link. Can we quick review copy, a11y, and telemetry?

maya: Nice. Question on jump: instant or animated? If instant, need undo.

trevor: prefer a short animation (~120ms) and respect prefers-reduced-motion; also add a keyboard shortcut to focus the minimap (e.g., press ".").

cheng: a11y notes: minimap must be tabbable, announce "viewport frames X-Y" via SR, and thumb contrast needs fix (current contrast 2.6:1). Recommend #6fbfff + 2px focus ring.

samir: telemetry: instrument minimap_open, minimap_jump (frame_index), trace_download, trace_copy_link. Include trace_id and origin.

olivia: copy decisions: use "Download trace JSON" and "Copy trace link" (short toast: "Trace link copied"). For downloads, announce via aria-live: "Download started".

a11ybot: auto-scan: thumb color fails contrast. Also suggest 44px touch target for mobile scrubber and aria-live for copy/download flows.

maya: I'll add an undo toast and wire aria-live. Trevor/cheng/samir please prototype keyboard, a11y fixes, and telemetry. I'll update Figma and follow up with a PR link.
